subject: Post-demo: sample audit extract & delivery plan for NovaPay
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Lily Chen <lily.chen@novapay.com>, Hector Alvarez <hector.alvarez@novapay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: sample audit extract & delivery plan for NovaPay

Hi Lily / Hector — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get you the exact "who did what / when" evidence you asked for during the demo.

Summary of asks we captured:
- Export of audit events for model invocations and admin console access (who, action, resource, timestamp).
- PII handling: prompts and user messages must not be included in full; you want either redacted text or a deterministic prompt hash.
- Retention window options and whether Redwood can provide exports for >90 days for compliance/legal.
- Export formats: CSV for quick review + JSONL for ingestion into your SIEM.
- Residency note: keep exports in US region (we heard this is preferred).

Proposed minimal deliverables (MVP) to unblock your security review:
1) audit_sample_7day.csv — 7-day slice with the following columns: timestamp_iso, timezone, canonical_user_id, role, resource_id, action, model_id, ip_address, prompt_hash, request_size_tokens, response_size_tokens, event_id
2) audit_sample_30day.jsonl — rolling 30-day sample in JSONL with full schema, pseudonymized user IDs and prompt_hash values
3) audit_extract_schema.md — mapping of fields, timezone handling, and redaction approach

Timeline: we can prepare the 7-day CSV and schema by Friday (2026-11-13) and the 30-day JSONL by Monday (2026-11-16) if that works. Delivery options: SFTP, secure Drive link, or direct upload to your intake endpoint. Please confirm preferred format and whether legal needs a statement about data residency/keys.

Attachments: I will include a short schema doc and point to a Drive folder when ready.

Next steps (asks for you):
- Confirm preferred delivery method (SFTP vs Drive) and contact for credential exchange.
- Confirm whether you want prompt_hash only or additionally pseudonymized prompt snippets.
- Any specific timezone standard (we default to UTC).

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
[attachment: audit_extract_schema.md (text/markdown, 4KB)]

From: Lily Chen <lily.chen@novapay.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hector Alvarez <hector.alvarez@novapay.com>, legal@novapay.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: sample audit extract & delivery plan for NovaPay

Kim — thanks for the clear recap. Below are clarifications from our security team so we can scope the sample correctly.

Required fields (minimum):
- timestamp (ISO 8601, include timezone offset)
- canonical_user_id (pseudonymized but consistent across exports)
- role (end user / admin / service_account)
- resource_id (e.g., model endpoint or console resource)
- action (invoke, edit-config, read, delete)
- ip_address (CIDR-safe masked last octet acceptable)
- model_id and model_variant
- request_headers_hash (to allow correlation without exposing headers)
- prompt_hash (SHA256) — do not include raw prompt text in exports
- request_id / event_id

Retention ask: Our compliance team is asking how Redwood can provide evidence for up to 7 years for certain regulated records. I understand default retention is shorter; please include a short note about export-based retention (i.e., we can produce historical exports upon request if data is retained in cold storage or via customer snapshot).

Formats: Provide both CSV and JSONL. CSV for quick internal review, JSONL for our ingestion.

We also attached our security questionnaire from the discovery — it'll help legal align on retention & residency specifics.

Thanks — Lily
Lily Chen
Security Manager, NovaPay
[attachment: NovaPay_Security_Q_11-11-26.pdf (application/pdf, 220KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lily Chen <lily.chen@novapay.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:43:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Post-demo: sample audit extract & delivery plan for NovaPay

Lily — thanks for the specifics, this is exactly what we needed. Quick plan from the delivery side:

What we'll provide:
- audit_sample_7day.csv: 7-day slice (CSV) with columns you listed; IPs will be masked at the last octet by default (we can provide full IPs under an NDA).
- audit_sample_30day.jsonl: 30-day JSONL with pseudonymized canonical_user_id and the same schema; prompt_hash will be SHA256 of the original prompt text.
- audit_extract_schema.md: includes exact column names, types, timezone handling (all timestamps will be in UTC and include offset), and pseudonymization notes.

PII handling: prompts will not be included; we will provide prompt_hash and a token-count metric. For admin console events where user emails appear (console-login), we'll pseudonymize and store the real-to-pseudonym mapping in our secure keystore; we will not include the real email in the export unless you request a redaction exception under a legal process.

Retention note: Redwood default hot retention is 90 days. For compliance, we can run archival exports for the date ranges you request. This is a manual export process for retention windows >90 days and we can include that in the SOW if needed (we can also recommend Redwood Dedicated for predictable long-term retention).

Delivery options: we can drop the artifacts in a secured Google Drive folder (link below) or push to an SFTP host you provide. For Drive we will restrict access to the two Novapay addresses and add an expiration link.

Tentative schedule:
- audit_sample_7day.csv + audit_extract_schema.md: Fri 2026-11-13 EOD PT
- audit_sample_30day.jsonl: Mon 2026-11-16 EOD PT

Can you confirm SFTP credentials or that the Drive link works for you?

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[attachment: audit_extract_schema.md (text/markdown, 4KB)]
